name: Simeon
description: A live UI REPL — describe an interface and watch an agent stream it into being, one row at a time

settings.label: Extra row smoothing (ms)
settings.description: Rows already arrive one at a time as the model writes them, so this is off by default. Raise it only to slow a burst down further.

settings.label: Show the row feed
settings.description: Mirror every row the agent emits in a side rail, so you can read the language as it streams
